DKM2019.title: Non-Asymptotic Pure Exploration by Solving Games

paper.locator: Section2.1; Algorithm1; Section2.2 Theorem1; Section2.3; Section3.1; Section4

DKM2019.applicability: Finite-arm structured one-parameter exponential-family identification explicitly includes Bernoulli and general finite answer maps. A registered finite rational-angle single-frequency mean model fits this structure. Compact-interior and exact-oracle assumptions must still be respected for the efficiency theorem.

KK2021.title: Mixture Martingales Revisited with Applications to Sequential Tests and Confidence Intervals
KK2021.applicability: General exponential-family/Bernoulli time-uniform all-arm GLR calibration; the smaller Gaussian-specific formulas are not substituted.

FWSP2025.title: Pure Exploration via Frank-Wolfe Self-Play
FWSP2025.theorem1_exact_scope: BAI in unstructured single-parameter exponential-family bandits and BAI in Gaussian linear bandits; convergence of the static information-allocation game.
FWSP2025.two_psr_arm_case: For fixed twoPSR arms, sign(C) equals which Bernoulli mean is larger, so the static unstructured BernoulliBAI game falls inside the stated theorem.
FWSP2025.six_arm_single_frequency_case: A Bernoulli mean-linear physical-cone model with answer sign(C) is not automatically covered by the Gaussian-linearBAI result. Merely listing Bernoulli in the general model discussion is insufficient.
FWSP2025.learning_and_stopping_gap: Section6 assumes a structure-respecting posterior update/sample oracle and explicitly leaves theoretical analysis of the proposed learner for future work. No complete delta-correct Bernoulli-single-frequency sign stopping protocol is supplied by that result.
FWSP2025.single_opposite_component: For a fixed sign, the closed opposite physical cone is one convex component. The skeptic simplex over alternative components is a singleton; this does not prove the missing learning/stopping guarantee.
FWSP2025.code_status: No author-linked FWSP executable repository was identified in the inspected current paper/abstract. The web-search connector failed; no global absence-of-code claim is made.

runner.locator: Bernoulli initialization repeats each arm until both outcomes appear; GLRT before each new draw

task_examples.locator: SameSign tests all arm means relative to a known threshold; it is not this unknown-A C-sign model

paper_vs_code_differences: Printed Algorithm1 initializes each arm once and uses cumulative RATIO tracking; official CTracking uses count-minus-cumulative-target tracking.
Official Bernoulli runner may spend multiple initialization pulls per arm until observing both0 and1. At a physical endpoint it need not finish; this is not the one-pull paper initialization.

Section4 explicitly calls beta=log((1+log(t))/delta) and f=log(t) unlicensed by theory. The official plot protocol is therefore not used as a formally1% certified baseline without an additional proof.

Official SameSign is a different answer model. Its glrt subtracts feasible-model fit from opposite-model fit, whereas the printed generic GLR uses the saturated exponential-family numerator. For structured data these need not agree.
official_code_components.oracle_truth_warning: Official FixedWeights/oracle allocations in plots consume the true model and are labelled oracle benchmarks. They must not be used as an executable paid-data strategy.

concrete_implementable_protocol.name: DKM2019 Algorithm1 Section3.1 finite-rational-grid Bernoulli C-sign adaptation with KK21 stopping
concrete_implementable_protocol.grid: Freeze before observations: six arms(cos,sin)=(-3/5,+/-4/5),(0,+/-1),(3/5,+/-4/5), or a separately preregistered matched rational grid.
concrete_implementable_protocol.physical_model: p_a=A+B*cos_a+C*sin_a; Omega={0<=A<=1,sqrt(B^2+C^2)<=min(A,1-A)}; answers sign(C), opposite closure sign*C<=0.
concrete_implementable_protocol.input_contract: Only fixed arms, paid per-arm integer(N,S), declareddelta/margin/tolerances and internal state; no trueA/B/C or case-dependent prior/allocation.
concrete_implementable_protocol.initialization: Exactly one paid pull per arm for the paper protocol. Any official-code-style initialization is a separately named and fully charged variant.
concrete_implementable_protocol.design_domain: Declare eta=1e-6 and the contracted physical model eta+(1-2eta)*X*u, u inOmega. Clip empirical means for design to[eta,1-eta]. Do not claim the original compact-interior efficiency theorem for true boundary cases outside this design assumption.
concrete_implementable_protocol.projection: Build per-arm KL intervals with f(n)=x+log(x)+1/2, x=(1+a)(1+b)log(n), a=b=.1. Minimize sumN_a KL(mu_hat_a,mu_a) over model/interval intersection; select the sign of the fittedC. Distinguish proven empty intersection from a numerical projection failure.
concrete_implementable_protocol.stop_order: Select the sign and test it on the SAME current paid counts before planning or drawing another observation.
concrete_implementable_protocol.best_response: Per selected answer, query AdaHedge for weightsw; minimize sumw_a KL(mu_hat_a,p_a(lambda)) on the opposite contracted cone. Require a logged certified gap tolerance or explicit unresolved status, not only an optimizer success flag.
concrete_implementable_protocol.optimism: U_a=max(f(n)/N_a,KL(interval_lower_a,p_a(lambda)),KL(interval_upper_a,p_a(lambda))). Update that answer-specific AdaHedge with loss-U.
concrete_implementable_protocol.tracking: Paper protocol: initialize accumulated target to paid initial counts; addw; choose argminN_a/target_a. A count-minus-target official-code variant must be separately labelled and fixed before comparison.
concrete_implementable_protocol.schedule: One physical shot per update and current-count stopping after every paid observation. Batch/checkpoint coarsening is a separately named adaptation.
concrete_implementable_protocol.cap_and_abstention: Charge all observations including initialization, errors, and cap-abstention paths. At finite cap output abstain unless the common valid certificate passes. C=0 has error protection but no finite-termination or power guarantee.
concrete_implementable_protocol.comparison_fairness: Use matched grid, cap, delta, monitoring and stopping-calibration opportunities for new methods and literature controls. Report per-case correct-stop power and unconditional cost; do not compare90%-power costs as95%-power baselines.

KK21_primary.C_exp: 2*h_tilde_(3/2)((h_inverse(1+x)+log(2*zeta(2)))/2), with h(u)=u-logu and the KK21 piecewise h_tilde definition.
KK21_primary.numerical_acceptance: Outward lower bound onZ strictly greater than outward upper threshold. The optimizer is merely a proposal; the null likelihood needs a global concavity/support upper bound.
KK21_primary.common_error_event: Whenever a selected sign is false, the true physical mean vector lies in that opposite cone. ItsZ is no larger than the all-arm saturated-to-true KL statistic controlled by KK21. Both signs, including any report atC=0, share one event of probability<=delta; no unlicensed double delta budget.
KK21_primary.boundary_scope: Bernoulli support-edge extension needs a finite-history continuity/contraction argument; it extends validity, not exact-oracle efficiency.

KT_secondary_adaptation.label: DKM sampling plus product-Jeffreys universal-inference stopping; explicitly not the original plot threshold
KT_secondary_adaptation.proof_requirement: Predictable fixed-arm selection makesQ a normalized sequential law; Q/L_true is a common nonnegativeLR martingale(supermartingale on support edges). Every false-sign rejection implies this same process crosses1/delta.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not use the stylised official plot threshold as a proven1% boundary.
Do not use empirical input truth or oracle allocations to help the policy.
Do not use local optimized null likelihood as an upper bound without certification.
Do not infer sample-complexity optimality from an absolute1e-5 floating best-response gap.

current_implementation_gap.already_corrected: The initial huge-oracle-gap and stale-label probe predates the current frozenbaseline. Current code added pooled restarts, convex linear extension, cone repair, line corrections and current-count stopping order; the old issue file is retained, not treated as current performance.
remaining_gaps: Absolute floating1e-5 gap can be large relative to a weak-signal information game; certified accuracy and accumulated approximate-oracle regret are still needed.
Projection may fail numerically; this is not evidence the model-confidence intersection is empty.
No step-by-step run of the pinned official Julia implementation has been completed.
Six-arm full-rank physical-cone and continuous-angle controllers have different action sets; same-grid controls are necessary for attribution.
A strict valid KK21 threshold differs from the paper plotted threshold; report both formula and scope rather than claiming complete original reproduction.

completed_component.mathematics: Exact rational feasible proposal and gradient; F(u)-minF<=gradient.u+support_opposite(-gradient), outward enclosed. Accept only if gap_upper<=atol+rtol*certified optimum_lower. The point is an optimizer proposal, not case truth.
completed_component.exact_psr_component: For two fixedPSR arms the opposite-answer Bernoulli KL best response is exact weighted isotonic pooling, or unchanged empirical means when already in the opposite ordering; no optimizer or true parameters are required.
completed_component.finite_checks: Six deterministic analytic PSR count/weight/sign cases, mirrored/support-edge/zero-weight cases, a six-arm observed-count proposal, exact infeasibility rejection, and an explicit weak-signal absolute-tolerance counterexample. No RNG or new samples.
completed_component.counterexample_scope: A constructed feasible weak-signal proposal has gap about1.11e-7, below the old1e-5 gate but rejected by1e-12+0.1% relative accuracy. This demonstrates insufficiency of the tolerance guarantee, not an allegation that the currentold runner generated this point.
completed_component.not_yet_done: The component has not been integrated into a new full sampled DKM run. It does not establish an exact-oracle efficiency theorem, a runtime advantage, a95%-power result, or SOTA superiority.

final_claim_boundary: A concrete auditable literature-control protocol and a repaired accuracy-certification component are available. The full finite-grid Bernoulli-single-frequency controller is an adaptation of DKM ideas with stated valid stopping, not the original paper experimental protocol or a complete FWSP reproduction.
